hooks.command: "$HOME"/.aidd/bin/aidd hook pre-tool || { echo "aidd: the guard could not run on this machine. Install aidd (https://github.com/thaithienvanid/aidd#get-started) if it is missing, then run aidd init --harness codex; aidd doctor says why. A project that requires the guard blocks each step until then" >&2; unset -f test 2>/dev/null; d=$PWD; while test -n "$d" && ! test -r "$d/.aidd/config.yaml"; do d=${d%/*}; done; if { unset -f test read true false 2>/dev/null; test "${AIDD_HOOK_FAIL_CLOSED:-}" = 1 || { f=; test -r "$d/.aidd/config.yaml" && while IFS= read -r l || test -n "$l"; do case $l in profile:*|mode:*) k=${l%%:*}; v=${l#*:}; v=${v%%#*}; while case $v in ' '*|'	'*) true;; *) false;; esac; do v=${v#?}; done; while case $v in *' '|*'	'|*'') true;; *) false;; esac; do v=${v%?}; done; v=${v#\"}; v=${v#\'}; v=${v%\"}; v=${v%\'}; case $k:$v in profile:org|profile:audited|mode:enforce) f=1;; esac;; esac; done < "$d/.aidd/config.yaml"; test "$f" = 1; }; }; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"aidd: the guard could not run on this machine. Install aidd (https://github.com/thaithienvanid/aidd#get-started) if it is missing, then run aidd init --harness codex; aidd doctor says why. A project that requires the guard blocks each step until then"}}'; fi; }
